_comment: (spec §5.5 the anchor-stone-per-region idiom -- the #10/#12/#16 contract) Each row is one fast-travel DESTINATION: {id, display_name, map, cell, requires_accomplishment, arrival_toast}.

portals.arrival_toast: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.
portals._comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4), the DAY-ONE LISCOR LINK: this row and `the_wandering_inn` re-gate door_awakened -> door_mounted. The Magical Door carries the inn<->Liscor hop from the moment it is hung (spec section 2.5 -- Pisces's mounting line is the in-fiction proof), and door_awakened now means 'reaches BEYOND Liscor', which is what the three region rows below still wait on. Old saves reach door_mounted through Task 2.6's backfill, so no shipped save loses a destination it already had.

portals.arrival_toast: Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.
portals._comment: Day-one Liscor link (Task 2.4) -- see liscor_street's row. Arrival cell (13,6) is one WEST of pantry_door (14,6) and stays clear of `pisces_mounting` (13,5), whose own window closes at the very counter this row opens on.

portals.arrival_toast: The light warms and the air smells of wheat and river water before you've taken a step. Riverfarm, same as the rumor said.
portals._comment: Arrival cell (13,5) sits one cell east of riverfarm_anchor_stone (12,5) at the village's own end of the pair, open + off every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map (blast-radius checked).

portals.arrival_toast: The light turns pale and cool, and the noise of a much bigger city rushes in to fill the silence. Invrisil, same as the letter promised.
portals._comment: Arrival cell (4,8) sits one cell east of invrisil_anchor_stone (3,8) at the boulevard's own end of the pair, open + off every blocked/decor/entity cell on that map (blast-radius checked).

portals.arrival_toast: The light sharpens and the air turns to hot metal and stone dust. Pallass, tier on tier, rising past where you can see the top.
portals._comment: pallass_attuned banks from Krshia's attunement-stone purchase (data/dialogue/krshia_crate.json's 'charms' node, gated on pallass_sponsored), the SAME late-attuning shape as invrisil_attuned.

portals.arrival_toast: The light dims into torchlit stone, and the deep hush of the dungeon closes back around you. You know this quiet.
